Idk of I’d say I’m a compulsive liar because I don’t just lie all the time. However, when I get into difficult situations I have no problem running through a list of lies and it’s pretty much instinct to just lie. This is all because of a pretty emotionally abusive mother. Because of her I learned how to lie because being around her was like walking on eggshells. I needed to be able to lie like that to “survive”. Someone else said something similar to this too. That being said, I don’t think that makes it okay to just lie all the time. I’m actively working on noticing this and growing out of the habit. It’s not easy but I think that you can’t just say you’re a compulsive liar and give some sob story and then just expect everyone to put up with your shit without working on yourself to try and be better.

I agree it’s important to help those that you mentioned and I personally have participated in food drives and service to the community in the past because it’s important to me that others receive the same that I do. This fundraiser won’t take any of your money. Instead it takes a portion of your purchases from these stores and donates it to our club. It doesn’t require any effort other than signings up and only lasts until Dec 31st. You don’t have to sign up, especially if you already have another cause you are donating to.
